releaseNotes:
### Improvements and fixes

- Refine the assistant appearance library, favorites and recent looks, with clearer saving and restoration behavior.
- Improve plugin connection setup, session login, account labels and Gmail authorization refresh.
- Improve browser viewport screenshots, click coordinates, scrolling, tab sizing, history suggestions and site icons.
- Make View menu zoom controls consistently scale the application interface, including when an embedded page has keyboard focus.
- Keep responsive sidebar drawers above embedded browser pages, with reliable search dialogs and dismissal.
- Improve Widget image loading and external link handling, and refine the floating composer layout.
- Clarify Windows Store update readiness and installation progress, remove the redundant Pudding install confirmation, and retain running-task checks.

### Upgrade notes

- The local database upgrades from v55 to v57 with an automatic backup. Restore a matching backup before downgrading.
- Platform requirements remain the same as 0.8.0.
- Windows availability follows Microsoft Store certification and rollout separately from the Mac release.
